description.narrative: Projektets övergripande mål är att främja respekten av mänskliga rättigheter i samband med omställningen från fossilbaserade till mer hållbara energikällor i Afrika; den så kallade "rättvisa omställningen". Målet ska bla nås genom att stärka kunskapen om, och implementeringen av, principer för ansvarsfullt företagande (Responsible Business Conduct, RBC) bland aktörer på nationell, regional och kontinental nivå. Insatsen är menad som en första fas, en sk inledningsperiod, av det förväntade och betydligt mer omfattande projektet "Supporting a Just Transition in Africa Through Responsible Business Conduct". Inledningsperioden är avsedd att löpa från 1 september 2023 – 30 april 2024. Baserat på erfarenheterna från inledningsperioden är tanken att det större programmet ska ta vid i mitten av 2024 och fortsätta till mitten av 2027.

This intervention is meant to serve as an inception period of the anticipated full-fledged project ‘Supporting a Just Transition in Africa Through Responsible Business Conduct’ project. The inception period is designed to run from 1 September 2023 – 30 April 2024, paving the way for the larger project actualisation and implementation from mid­ 2024 to mid­ 2027. The overall objective of the project is to support the promotion and protection of human rights in the context of the energy transition in Africa. This overall objective will be realised through stakeholder capacity building and dialogue in support of responsible business conduct (RBC).

This intervention is meant to serve as an inception period of the anticipated fullfledged project "Supporting a Just Transition in Africa Through Responsible Business Conduct". The inception period is designed to run from 1 September 2023 - 30 April 2024, paving the way for the larger project actualisation and implementation from mid 2024 to mid 2027. The inception period is budgeted at 5 MSEK, with an anticipated subsequent project budget of approximately 55 MSEK. The project will be implemented by a consortium consisting of three to five partners, mainly from the African region, under the lead by the Danish Institute for Human Rights (DIHR).
The overall objective of the project is to support the promotion and protection of human rights in the context of the energy transition in Africa. This overall objective will be realised through stakeholder capacity building and dialogue in support of responsible business conduct (RBC) within four envisaged workstreams to be confirmed and further elaborated on during this inception period: (1) Documenting human rights impacts associated with the energy transition (2) Regional and national multistakeholder policy dialogue (3) Supporting access to remedy for human rights abuses associated with the energy transition and (4) Integrating human rights in finance and investment for the Just Transition. Project design is envisaged to comprise activities at the regional level and in three focus countries (will be confirmed in the inception period).
